summary: Projects are collections of playbooks placed under the Project Base Path (/var/lib/awx/projects, set in /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py) or pulled from Git, Subversion, Mercurial or Red Hat Lightspeed; a Demo Project is provided, large projects can fill /tmp, and Pending means waiting for dependencies or capacity.
questions: What is the project base path in automation controller?
Why is my project update stuck in Pending?
Which SCM types do projects support?
